question: For alien data, how many of the top 10 states by alien population have a higher percentage of friendly aliens than hostile aliens, with an average alien age exceeding 200?
sql:
WITH top10_states AS (
    SELECT state, COUNT(*) as population
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
    ORDER BY population DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
state_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        COUNT(*) as total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count,
        AVG(age) as avg_age
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM top10_states t
JOIN state_stats s ON t.state = s.state
WHERE s.avg_age > 200 
  AND s.friendly_count * 100.0 / s.total > s.hostile_count * 100.0 / s.total

args.sql:
WITH top10_states AS (
    SELECT state, COUNT(*) as population
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
    ORDER BY population DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
state_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        COUNT(*) as total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count,
        AVG(age) as avg_age
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM top10_states t
JOIN state_stats s ON t.state = s.state
WHERE s.avg_age > 200 
  AND s.friendly_count * 100.0 / s.total > s.hostile_count * 100.0 / s.total
